story.title: Whole night, mild severity (5.8)
story.watch: Mild night, AHI 5.8: 12/14 arousal-linked events covered with 15 separate advances, jaw forward 19% of the night against 100% for a fixed MAD.

model.pack: no hypnogram-wake (deployable), 1 Hz every cannula-valid second after 600 s lookback
model.fusion: Advance only if fire_now is above threshold (early-warn when pre_onset also high; rescue when active is also high). active-only holds if already advanced. pre_onset without fire_now does not actuate.

cohort.selection: MESA 3901 was chosen as a severity example (NSRR AHI 5.8), not as the top-ranked night. Fewer events per hour means more quiet between clusters, so each advance and retract is a separate visible decision.

meta.disclaimer: Untreated PSG: coverage is timing (advance completed before the arousal deadline), not proven event or arousal prevention.
